1.title: Blueprint
1.text: Bulma has covered the lounge table with schematics for something she refuses to explain. You bring her coffee and she waves you into the seat beside her without looking up. "Genius needs company," she says, hooking her ankle around yours under the table. "Preferably cute." She finally glances over, smirking. "You're blushing, Sam. Good—I'd hate to be the only one." Gears and glass tubes cover the table, a pencil is stuck in her hair, and her knee presses warm against your thigh.

image.comp: leaning over a table of blueprints with a smirk, one eyebrow raised, hair swept to one side
image.setting: lounge table covered with schematics, coffee and a desk lamp

1.goRes: She laughs softly into your mouth before deepening the kiss, her fingers tangling in your hair. "Best idea you've had all week," she purrs.
1.waitRes: "Ha! Cute and committed." She winks and taps her pencil against your knee. "Don't think I won't circle back."

2.title: Prototype
2.text: Bulma proudly presents a rickety lantern that blooms into a hundred little sparks before fizzling out. Your fingers brush hers as you help fix the wiring, and she catches your hand instead of letting go. "Okay, so I'm usually the smartest person in the room," she murmurs, sliding her palm straight down over your belt. "But you keep distracting me—so let's run a hands-on test." A warm blue light flickers over her smirk as her fingers work at your buckle.

image.comp: holding a sparkling prototype lantern, leaning into him with a bright smirk
image.setting: workshop corner with tools, a spark-lit lantern and open wires

2.goRes: Sparks fly in more than one sense—she gets you out of your trousers and studies every twitch and groan with wicked, thorough curiosity.
2.waitRes: "Pfft. Fine, fine." She gives you one last teasing squeeze through your trousers and waves a screwdriver. "Top of the project list, though."

3.title: Night Shift
3.text: Bulma has stayed up three nights with a project and finally flops onto your bed, boots on, hair wild, tugging her top off over her head without an ounce of shame. "I'm brilliant, I'm exhausted, and I'm tired of sleeping alone," she mumbles, baring her breasts in the lamplight. One bright eye opens as she pats the mattress. "Since I'm already half-naked in your bed—stay and wear me out?"

image.comp: sprawled across a bed with boots on and hair a mess, one eye open with a sleepy grin
image.setting: Sam's bedroom, dim and cozy, a pile of schematics on the floor

3.goRes: You pull her boots and shorts off, and she turns out to be nowhere near as sleepy as she claimed once you're between her thighs.
3.waitRes: "Ugh. Responsible." She curls up naked under your blanket, grinning into the pillow. "Fine—tomorrow morning I'm cashing this in."

jump.title: Spark
jump.text: Bulma's gadget pops in a harmless cloud of glitter, leaving you both coughing and laughing in the storeroom. She wipes sparkles from your cheek, pauses, and lets her hand trail down your chest to your belt. "Huh," she purrs, eyes darkening as she presses her hips against yours. "Completely unplanned—and way better than the blueprint. Let's lock the door."

image.comp: covered in glitter and laughing, face close to his, wiping sparkles from his cheek
image.setting: storeroom with scattered gadget parts and drifting glitter

jump.goRes: She bolts the storeroom door, strips out of her glitter-dusted clothes, and insists afterward that finding sparkles everywhere for days was worth every second.
jump.waitRes: "Chicken." She grins, unbothered, and flicks glitter at your chest. "I can wait—I'm brilliant, not patient."

1.title: Rules
1.text: Chi-Chi runs the household like a general and the kitchen like a kingdom. Caught sneaking a pastry, you get a wooden ladle pointed straight at your nose. "Wash up and sit." You obey. She plates you a proper meal and watches you eat with an unexpectedly soft, flustered look. "You're too thin," she says gruffly, stepping close enough that her apron brushes your knee. "Somebody needs to take proper care of you."

image.comp: holding a ladle with a stern but affectionate expression, watching him eat
image.setting: warm kitchen at night with simmering pots and a lit hearth

1.goRes: She sputters, turns bright red, and swats your arm with a dish towel—before grabbing your collar and kissing you back hungrily.
1.waitRes: "Hmph." She smooths her apron, cheeks burning. "Then eat the second helping. I'm not giving up."

2.title: Martial Arts
2.text: Chi-Chi drills you on a basic stance in the courtyard, correcting your footing with a firm tap. "Straight back. Breathe. No, like this!" She steps behind you, pressing flush against your back with her hands gripping your hips—and freezes when she feels how hard you are. "...Oh," she breathes against your shoulder, her fingers tightening on your waist instead of letting go. "Well. That's... certainly good posture."

image.comp: standing behind him adjusting his stance with her hands at his hips, a flushed stern smile
image.setting: courtyard in afternoon sun with a practice mat

2.goRes: Red-faced and fiercely decisive, she drags you straight inside behind a closed door to put her hands—and mouth—to work.
2.waitRes: "Fine. But posture practice is mandatory." She pats your chest, ears bright crimson.

3.title: Homemaker
3.text: Chi-Chi fusses with your blankets herself, and then, unexpectedly, doesn't leave. "I've spent my life being a wife and a cook and a teacher," she says softly, unpinning her hair so it spills down her back. She sits on the edge of your mattress, unbuttoning her top with slightly trembling fingers. "Nobody ever asks what I want. Tonight I want to be held—and taken properly—by someone who appreciates me."

image.comp: sitting at the edge of a bed in an apron, hands twisting in her lap, brave and tender
image.setting: Sam's bedroom with a patchwork quilt and one candle

3.goRes: You pull her down onto the mattress, strip away the apron and dress, and when you push inside her she lets out a long, trembling, deeply satisfied moan.
3.waitRes: "Don't you dare be polite at me." She squeezes your hand, cheeks flushed. "Another night, then—and I'm holding you to it."

jump.title: Flour on Her Cheek
jump.text: Chi-Chi has flour dusted across her cheek and a pie in the oven when you pause to wipe it off gently with your thumb. She goes completely still, her chest rising fast. "...Well." Her ladle clatters onto the counter. "That was bold." Her stern expression melts into a flush. "Bolt the kitchen door and take me upstairs before the pie burns."

image.comp: wiping flour from her cheek, ladle lowered, a stern look breaking into a smile
image.setting: kitchen with flour dusted counters and a pie baking

jump.goRes: She kisses you breathless, hikes up her skirts the second you reach your room, and makes you forget all about the oven.
jump.waitRes: "The pie!" She dashes to the oven, red from her collarbone up, avoiding your eyes for five straight minutes.

1.title: Taste Test
1.text: Android 21 holds a spoon of your stew out to you, her eyes half-lidded in breathless bliss. "Eleven spices. Three I can't even identify." Her voice is polite, velvety, and thick with hunger as she sets the spoon down and leans across the counter toward you. "I try very hard to keep my appetites disciplined, Sam—and your scent is making that nearly impossible."

image.comp: holding a spoon out to him with half-closed eyes, a polite flushed smile and visible hunger
image.setting: bar counter late at night with simmering pots and spice jars

1.goRes: She tastes like warm sugar and static electricity, parting her lips to suck gently on your tongue before pulling back dazed. "Fascinating. I need a much larger sample."
1.waitRes: "Understood." She folds her hands neatly, though her eyes stay fixed on your throat. "I'll try to behave. I make no promises about my appetite."

2.title: Research Notes
2.text: Android 21 tallies flavors in a leather notebook at the end of the bar, long fingers curled around her pen. "Subject: Sam. Observation: warm, responsive. Hypothesis: tastes even better naked." She freezes, scarlet to her ears, and snaps the book shut. "I did not mean to say that aloud. Or write it down. Please ignore the data."

image.comp: snapping a notebook shut with a mortified blush, polite smile, eyes lingering
image.setting: end of the bar with a notebook, a stack of spice jars, low lantern

2.goRes: She hums with delighted, shameless hunger, slipping behind the counter to unbuckle your trousers and conduct a very thorough oral study.
2.waitRes: "Of course." Her smile is polite, flushed, and starving. "I'll revise the timeline—though the hypothesis stands."

3.title: Appetite
3.text: Android 21 appears in your bedroom doorway holding an empty plate and wearing a fitted cardigan unbuttoned halfway down her cleavage. "I've eaten everything in the pantry, and I'm still starving," she admits with a wry, breathless smile, stepping inside and closing the door. "Not for food. I'm terrible at denying myself once I've tasted something sweet—may I have all of you tonight?"

image.comp: standing in a doorway holding an empty plate, tall figure in lamplight, wry apologetic smile
image.setting: Sam's room, lamplit, a plate left on the table

3.goRes: She sheds the cardigan, straddles your hips with insatiable, polite enthusiasm, and rides you until dawn—leaving a single word in her notebook: 'Exquisite.'
3.waitRes: "Understood." She sets the plate down neatly, swallowing hard. "I'll go find something else to bite. Don't feel guilty."

jump.title: Midnight Snack
jump.text: You catch Android 21 in the pantry at three in the morning with a wheel of cheese under one arm. She stiffens, guilty, before the cheese thuds onto the shelf and her gaze drops straight to your groin. "I can explain—high metabolism," she purrs, backing you against the pantry door and reaching for your belt. "Actually, I have a much deeper appetite. Care for a practical demonstration?"

image.comp: caught in the pantry with a wheel of cheese, guilty then amused, leaning toward him
image.setting: kitchen pantry with shelves of food and a single hanging lantern

jump.goRes: The cheese is completely forgotten as she pulls you down onto a pile of sacks, strips off her clothes, and devours you thoroughly.
jump.waitRes: "Tea. Lovely." She picks up the cheese with a composed, hungry smile. "We'll discuss appetites over a pot."

1.title: Rooftop Wind
1.text: Lyn's patrol ends on the roof, where the wind comes straight off the plains road and she can finally breathe. You climb up with two mugs of tea. "Four walls make me itchy," she admits, leaning against the chimney. "Funny—you're the first thing in this town that doesn't." She hasn't stopped watching you since you sat down, and her fingers brush yours on the warm tiles, close enough that neither of you pulls away.

image.comp: leaning against a chimney with her ponytail whipping in the wind, a sideways grin, mug in hand
image.setting: rooftop of the house at dusk, the town's lantern-lit roofs below

1.goRes: She tastes of spiced tea and open sky, and when she laughs softly against your mouth, she grabs your shirt to pull you back in.
1.waitRes: "Careful is for people who lose." She bumps her shoulder into yours, grinning, pink around the ears.

2.title: Sparring Rematch
2.text: Lyn drags you to the yard behind the stables for a lesson with practice swords, which you lose in four seconds flat. She pins you on your back in the straw, straddling your hips, breathing hard and flushed from the exertion. "Ha! Again?" Then she feels how hard you are beneath her, and her cocky grin softens into heat. "...Or we could call it a draw, and I use my hands instead."

image.comp: standing over him with a practice sword, flushed and breathless, a confident smile softening
image.setting: stable yard behind the house in late afternoon light, straw and training dummies

2.goRes: She tosses the wooden blade into the straw and drags you into the tack room—and Lyn is every bit as competitive with her hands and mouth.
2.waitRes: "Coward." She laughs, rolls off your lap, and tosses you a towel. "Fine—I'll win the next two, then collect my prize."

3.title: Out of the Rain
3.text: A thunderstorm finally drives Lyn off the roof. She shows up in your doorway soaked to the skin, her wet clothes clinging to every curve, scowling at the ceiling like it's a personal insult. "Don't say a word—I'm not used to sleeping indoors." She hovers, dripping, before peeling off her soaked tunic and baring her chest in the firelight. "I'm not spending the night alone, Sam. Make room."

image.comp: standing in a doorway wet from rain, green ponytail dripping, awkward but earnest expression
image.setting: Sam's bedroom with a small fire lit, rain streaming down the window

3.goRes: You strip off the rest of her wet clothes, wrap her up in your sheets, and warm her up thoroughly until the storm is completely forgotten.
3.waitRes: "Right. Practical." She huffs, though a grin tugs at her mouth. "I'll dry by the fire—don't think I'm leaving your bed."

jump.title: Overdue Challenge
jump.text: Lyn has been circling you for weeks and hates hesitating. She finally corners you in the dim hallway by the back stairs, slamming a hand against the wall beside your head and pressing her thigh between yours. "I don't do slow—I've turned down lords and armies, and I'm not losing to a bookworm in a hoodie," she growls, reaching straight for your belt. "Let's take this upstairs. Now."

image.comp: pinning a hand against the wall beside him, fierce grin, a faint blush across her nose
image.setting: narrow back-stairs hallway of the house, lantern light

jump.goRes: She kisses you at a full sprint, kicks open your bedroom door, and rides you like she's conquering territory.
jump.waitRes: "A minute." She narrows her eyes, squeezes your hip once, and snorts. "I've waited on armies longer. I'll be on the roof."

1.title: Evening Vespers
1.text: Rhea has turned the little alcove off the east hall into a quiet sanctuary with tall candles and a single brass bell. You find her there after closing. "I tended a great many souls once," she says, serene as a held breath, resting a cool, impossibly gentle hand against your cheek. "Tonight I find I would rather tend just one."

image.comp: standing among candles in a small chapel nook, one hand raised to his cheek, a serene and tender smile
image.setting: tiny candlelit chapel in a storeroom, brass bell, folded vestments

1.goRes: Her lips are cool at first, then scorching warm, parting beneath yours with a long, trembling sigh like someone setting down an ancient weight.
1.waitRes: "Of course." She smiles, unoffended and unhurried. "I have waited centuries, Sam—I can wait for your heart to catch up."

2.title: Confession
2.text: She asks you to sit with her in the moonlit garden alcove, where the lanterns burn low. "Mortals used to kneel before me to confess," Rhea murmurs, her fingers lacing warmly through yours before guiding your hand onto her thigh. "No one has asked for my confession in a very long time. I want to be touched—pleasured—without being worshipped. Can you give me that?"

image.comp: seated on a garden bench, holding his hand in both of hers, an uncertain, honest expression
image.setting: moonlit garden alcove with hanging lanterns and night-blooming flowers

2.goRes: You hike up her robes and touch her with unhurried devotion until her quiet, breathless gasps turn into shuddering moans against your shoulder.
2.waitRes: "Slowly." She laughs, low and pleased. "Yes. You understand mercy better than most priests. We shall go slowly."

3.title: A Night Without Vigil
3.text: Rhea is waiting in her room with the candles lit low, her silver hair unbound and spilling past her waist over bare shoulders as her robe falls open. "I have kept vigil for the faithful for six hundred years," she whispers, her hands trembling slightly on her sash. "Tonight I wish to be nothing more than a woman thoroughly taken in bed. Will you stay?"

image.comp: sitting at the edge of a large bed in a loose robe, hands folded, a nervous but dignified smile
image.setting: elegant bedroom with soft candlelight and heavy curtains

3.goRes: You slide her robe off her shoulders, settle between her parted thighs, and worship her body until dawn without a single prayer spoken.
3.waitRes: "I am older than most mountains, Sam, and I am certain." A tender smile. "Take the night to be sure—I shall be waiting."

jump.title: Quiet Hour
jump.text: Rhea finds you alone in the kitchen past three in the morning, stirring warm milk. Without a word she takes the spoon, sets it aside, and presses her lush, warm body flush against yours. "I have been virtuous for a very long time," she purrs against your throat, her hand sliding down to your belt. "And I am tired of restraint."

image.comp: stepping close in a dim kitchen, spoon set aside, gaze steady and warm with a hint of mischief
image.setting: dim kitchen at night, a pot of milk steaming on the hearth

jump.goRes: Time seems to stop as she kisses you breathless, hikes up her skirts, and pulls you straight to bed like she's been starving for centuries.
jump.waitRes: "So you are." She laughs softly and pours herself a cup. "Then we shall sit—and I will find my courage over the dregs."

1.title: Encore
1.text: Manuela is still in her low-cut stage gown when you find her at the back of the empty hall, humming the last bars of an aria to the dusty chairs. "Nobody claps when the house is empty," she says with a wry laugh. "Be a darling and applaud." You do—and when she takes your hand for a theatrical bow, she presses close, letting you smell wine, perfume, and warm skin.

image.comp: taking a theatrical bow in a stage dress, one hand holding his, a playful and slightly vulnerable smile
image.setting: empty stage and hall after the show, a single lantern left lit

1.goRes: She hums a startled, delighted note right against your mouth, then parts her lips and kisses you like you're the only audience that matters.
1.waitRes: "Always the gentleman." She flutters her fan, winks, and sweeps off. "I'll keep the front row warm for you."

2.title: Husband Hunting
2.text: Manuela has been through four lemon wines and a long list of her romantic disasters. "Every man wants a diva or a physician," she sighs, leaning against you at the bar with her hand resting high on your thigh. "None of them ever ask how I take my tea—and you did." Her dark eyes drop straight to your groin. "Let me thank you properly, darling."

image.comp: slumped charmingly against the bar, chin on her hand, sad smile turning warm
image.setting: back corner of the bar, empty glasses, low lamp

2.goRes: Her theatrical patter melts into soft, breathless sighs as she slips into a back booth with you and puts her hands and mouth to eager work.
2.waitRes: "I know, dear." A rueful chuckle. "Hope is stubborn, though. Pour me another and let me pretend."

3.title: The Doctor Is In
3.text: Manuela appears in your bedroom doorway carrying a medical satchel and wearing nothing underneath her unbuttoned physician's coat. "Professional concern, darling—you've been overworking yourself," she purrs, dropping the satchel and pressing her bare chest against yours. "I'm prescribing wine, bedrest, and a very thorough physical examination."

image.comp: leaning in the doorway with a doctor's bag over one shoulder, hand on his chest, teasing smile
image.setting: Sam's bedroom lit by a single lamp, a bottle and two glasses on the table

3.goRes: Your pulse is, she declares breathlessly while straddling your hips, positively scandalous—and the treatment goes on for hours.
3.waitRes: "Doctors hear that every day, and it's always a lie." She pats your cheek with a wicked wink. "Rest tonight, then—I'll check on you later."

jump.title: Opera Fever
jump.text: Manuela sings her heart out for the lounge crowd, her rich voice rolling over the room like warm honey. When the final note fades, she ignores the applause, marches straight up to you, and kisses you breathless in front of everyone—her hand sliding shamelessly down your hip before she catches herself, turning scarlet. "Oh heavens—that was meant for behind closed doors!"

image.comp: caught mid-kiss then pulling back, hand to her cheeks, flustered and delighted
image.setting: lounge stage with lanterns and astonished patrons behind

jump.goRes: The lounge erupts into cheers as you sweep her straight upstairs to your bedroom, where she finishes the performance naked.
jump.waitRes: "Yes, yes—the dressing room! Forgive me, darling." She fans her flushed chest, eyes sparkling all the same.

1.title: Night Watch
1.text: Lethe is working the door shift, bristling and hostile to every shadow in the hall. You bring her a hot bowl of soup anyway. She sniffs it suspiciously, glares at you, and eats every bite. "Humans," she mutters, her tail twitching against your leg. "You give things and demand nothing. It puts me on edge." A beat. "...I do not hate it."

image.comp: sitting on a stool by the door with a bowl in her hands, ears angled toward him, guarded but softening
image.setting: front entrance hall at night, lantern on the wall, shut door

1.goRes: She sets the bowl aside, grabs your collar, and kisses you hard—brief, fierce, and warm, wiping her mouth afterward as if checking it was real.
1.waitRes: "I am." She narrows her eyes, ears flattening slightly. "You are the only one who asked for nothing. Remember that."

2.title: Grooming
2.text: Lethe stands in the washroom with her fur damp after a rainy patrol, scowling at a comb she can't reach behind her back. You offer to help, and she nearly hisses before stiffly turning around and presenting her tail. "Slowly. If you tug, I will bite." Her low purr starts on the second stroke—and by the fourth, she's leaning her ass back against your groin, trembling.

image.comp: back turned and tail held out, glancing over her shoulder with an embarrassed glare, ears flat then softening
image.setting: small washroom with warm steam and a single window, a comb on the sill

2.goRes: Her purr turns into a rough groan; she spins around, drops to her knees, and unbuckles your belt with fierce, possessive focus.
2.waitRes: "I will." Her tail wraps tightly around your wrist. "Not yet. Do not look so smug."

3.title: Claiming the Night
3.text: Lethe marches into your bedroom off-shift, arms crossed and tail lashing, kicking the door shut behind her. "I have thought it over. I distrust you less every week, and it is infuriating," she growls, pulling her top off and tossing it aside. "A warrior claims what she wants. I have decided I want you in my bed—now."

image.comp: stepping inside and kicking a door shut, arms crossed but a small shy smile tugging her mouth
image.setting: Sam's room with the window open to a clear cold night

3.goRes: She mounts you with fierce, demanding intensity—and by dawn she's curled purring against your chest, deeply offended at how good it felt.
3.waitRes: "I have thought—you are the slow one." She snorts, brushing her fingers along your arm. "Do not keep me waiting long."

jump.title: Claw Marks
jump.text: You lean in to pluck a loose thread from her cloak, and Lethe goes rigid, tail bristling—a heartbeat of pure hissing tension. Then she grabs your collar, slams you back against the wall, and kisses you hungrily, grinding her hips against yours. "Say nothing of this," she pants against your jaw, her hand dropping to your belt. "Do not tell the others. Come upstairs."

image.comp: gripping his collar, ears pinned, fierce and flustered glare after a kiss
image.setting: the hallway by the front door, shadows from a hanging lantern

jump.goRes: You keep your mouth shut except to kiss her back, following her upstairs where she tackles you onto the mattress.
jump.waitRes: "No." Ears pinned flat. Then, muffled: "...Later. Perhaps." She slips into the shadows before you can answer.

1.title: Moonlit Path
1.text: Panne walks the garden path alone every night and never explains why. Tonight you fall into step beside her without a word, and she lets you stay. "Most humans rush to fill silence," she says softly, tall in the silver moonlight with her long ears angled toward you. "You do not. I realized tonight I have stopped counting the exits whenever you are near."

image.comp: walking a moonlit garden path, long ears tilted toward him, a rare soft look
image.setting: garden path with lanterns and silver moonlight on the hedges

1.goRes: She laces her fingers through yours, turns after a quiet beat, and kisses you softly—lingering just long enough to make your heart race.
1.waitRes: "I will." The faintest smile curves her lips. "Do not mistake slow for no—patience is what my kind knows best."

2.title: Trust
2.text: Panne sits stiffly on the library window seat with her knees drawn up when you find her. "My people were hunted for what we are," she says quietly, eyes fixed on yours. "I was taught never to let strangers touch me—and you have not been a stranger for a long time." She uncurls her legs, parting them slightly, and holds out a trembling hand. "Touch me, Sam. Show me."

image.comp: seated in a window seat with knees up, one palm extended toward him, braced and hopeful
image.setting: quiet library nook with rain on the windowpane

2.goRes: You take her hand and guide her onto the cushions, touching her with slow, deliberate care until her trembling turns into soft, breathless gasps.
2.waitRes: "I know." She exhales shakily and holds onto your fingers. "That is why I dared to ask. Give me a moment."

3.title: Burrow
3.text: The room is dim when Panne lets you inside, transformed into a deep nest of heaped blankets and warm pillows in the corner. "I do not do this lightly," she whispers, her long ears drooping shyly as she slips out of her dress, baring her slender, athletic body in the lantern glow. "I have never brought anyone into my burrow. Come lie with me."

image.comp: sitting on a nest of blankets, patting the space beside her, long ears low and shy, tall frame folded small
image.setting: her private room with blankets heaped like a nest and a low lantern

3.goRes: You crawl into the nest of blankets beside her, wrapping her up in your arms and sliding slowly inside her warm, eager heat.
3.waitRes: "It is a great deal to give," she says gravely. "Think on it—I will keep the nest warm."

jump.title: Spring Hare
jump.text: On a restless spring night you find Panne pacing the dark kitchen, flushed and breathing fast, her ears twitching at every sound. The moment she sees you, she closes the distance, pressing her body hard against yours and kissing you with sudden, desperate heat. "Forgive me," she pants against your mouth, tugging at your shirt. "I have run my whole life—I am tired of running from wanting you."

image.comp: pressed close to him with her forehead against his, eyes closed, ears trembling
image.setting: dim kitchen with a window open to a warm spring night

jump.goRes: She lets out a breathless, startled laugh into your mouth before pulling you straight to her room and into her nest of blankets.
jump.waitRes: "I am. I think." She steps back a pace, chest heaving. "Give me a moment to gather my nerve again."

1.title: Sky Watcher
1.text: Corrin sits on the attic windowsill most nights, gazing out at the lantern-lit town as if memorizing a new map. You join her with a warm blanket. "Everything here feels so loud and alive," she murmurs dreamily, resting her head on your shoulder before tilting her chin up toward your lips, radiating a faint, feverish warmth.

image.comp: sitting on a window sill with a blanket around her shoulders, leaning against him, soft dreamy smile
image.setting: attic window above the rooftops with a view of town lights

1.goRes: Her lips are scorching warm, and she lets out a soft, astonished sigh as she melts into your arms.
1.waitRes: "Oh—yes, of course." She offers a shy, sleepy smile. "There's no rush at all."

2.title: Dragon Warm
2.text: Corrin's skin runs fever-hot whenever she's flustered—a quirk of her ancient blood. Tonight she stands in your doorway holding a steaming mug of cocoa, cheeks flushed gold and pupils slit with heat. "I tried to stay calm about this," she whispers, setting the mug down and laying her hot palms flat on your chest, sliding them slowly downward. "May I touch you? I'm burning up."

image.comp: standing in a doorway holding a steaming mug, eyes with a faint draconic glint, hopeful and nervous
image.setting: Sam's room, soft lamplight, a rug and shelf of books

2.goRes: Her hands are hot as hearthstones as she unfastens your trousers, eagerly learning every sound and shudder she can draw out of you.
2.waitRes: "Of course." She curls up beside you on the rug with a soft laugh. "I'll try to cool down a little."

3.title: Two Homes
3.text: Corrin sits cross-legged on your bed in a loose nightshift, holding an unfinished letter she's been writing for a month. "I always belonged to two worlds and neither felt truly mine," she says softly, setting the page aside and letting her shift slip off one bare shoulder. "You feel like home, Sam—and I want to be yours tonight, completely."

image.comp: sitting cross-legged on a bed holding an unfinished letter, glancing up with open sincerity
image.setting: Sam's bedroom with a quilt, lamplight, a night window

3.goRes: You pull her shift off and sink into her scorching, tight heat, holding her close as she gasps your name against your neck.
3.waitRes: "I think so." She hugs the letter to her chest, smiling warmly. "Let me finish this first—wait for me."

jump.title: Cold Hands
jump.text: Corrin finds you on the porch in the winter chill and presses your freezing hands between her fever-hot palms. "You're ice cold," she murmurs, stepping flush against you so her heat radiates right through your clothes. Looking up through the steam of her breath, her eyes darken. "I've been waiting for an excuse to warm you up properly—take me upstairs."

image.comp: holding his hands between hers with breath visible in cold air, shy and affectionate
image.setting: front porch in winter night with frost on the railings and warm lantern glow

jump.goRes: She kisses you breathless, leads you straight to your room, and wraps her hot, bare body around yours until winter is forgotten.
jump.waitRes: "Yes, of course." She squeezes your fingers tightly. "Inside, then—though I'm not letting go of you."

1.title: Posture
1.text: Eirika still carries herself as though wearing a crown, even while sweeping the lounge floor after closing. When you tease her gently about her royal posture, she starts to apologize, catches herself, and bursts into helpless laughter. "I don't think I've laughed like that since the war ended," she admits, stepping closer with bright, unguarded eyes.

image.comp: laughing helplessly with a broom in hand, composure slipping, hand over her mouth
image.setting: lounge after closing, chairs stacked, lanterns burning low

1.goRes: She kisses you with the earnest devotion she brings to everything, whispers a soft apology against your lips, and immediately kisses you again.
1.waitRes: "Of course—forgive me." She flushes warmly. "I tend to treat every feeling like a duty. Let me learn to simply enjoy this."

2.title: A Princess Off Duty
2.text: Eirika asks you to walk with her through the evening market—not as royalty, just as an ordinary woman. By the quiet canal edge, hair loose and cheeks flushed from chasing a runaway paper lantern, she catches your hands and pulls them to her waist. "Is this what it's like to just be a person?" she whispers, leaning into you in the shadows.

image.comp: standing at a canal edge with hair loose, laughing, flushed with delight
image.setting: evening market by a canal with paper lanterns and warm lights

2.goRes: Back in the quiet of the upstairs hall, she lets her royal reserve melt entirely, guiding your hands over her bare skin with breathless curiosity.
2.waitRes: "Yes, of course." She slips her arm snugly through yours anyway. "Walk me up the stairs, at least."

3.title: The Crown Set Down
3.text: Eirika sits on the edge of your bed in a thin nightgown, hands clasped tightly in her lap, cheeks crimson. "I have led armies and buried friends," she whispers, meeting your eyes with quiet courage. "Yet nobody ever asked what I desired. I want this—I want you inside me tonight. Please be patient with me."

image.comp: seated on the edge of a bed in a simple nightgown, hands clasped, brave and anxious
image.setting: Sam's room by candlelight, a plain coverlet and an open window

3.goRes: You slip off her nightgown and take her slowly, tenderly, until her nervous trembling gives way to breathless cries and clinging hands.
3.waitRes: "You're kind to offer." She nods, steadying her breath. "A few more days, then—I will gather my courage."

jump.title: Apologies
jump.text: Eirika collides with you in the corridor carrying an armful of linens and begins apologizing profusely before you steady her waist. She freezes, staring at your hands on her hips, her chest rising fast. "I have spent years apologizing for everything," she breathes, dropping the sheets and grabbing your collar. "I refuse to apologize for wanting you."

image.comp: kissing him with an armful of linens, eyes shut, a determined blush
image.setting: upstairs corridor with stacked linens and a dim sconce

jump.goRes: The linens stay forgotten on the floorboards as she pulls you into her bedroom, unlaces her dress, and surrenders completely.
jump.waitRes: "Oh! Forgive me!" Scarlet to her ears, she scoops up the sheets—then pauses. "...No. I'm not sorry. Only early."

1.title: Lesson Plan
1.text: Byleth is grading the staff's reading exercises at the kitchen table—unprompted—when you sit across from her. "You made an error on line four," she says evenly. "I left it uncorrected so you would come sit with me." Her expression doesn't shift a millimeter, though the tips of her ears turn bright pink.

image.comp: sitting at a table with a quill and papers, expression unreadable, ear faintly pink
image.setting: kitchen table with papers, a candle, and a half-finished tea

1.goRes: Her eyes widen by a fraction before she grabs your collar, pulls you across the table corner, and kisses you with startling, thorough focus.
1.waitRes: "Understood." She turns the page, her quill hovering a beat too long. "I will revise the schedule."

2.title: Massage Hours
2.text: Byleth works the knots out of your shoulders in the dim storeroom after a double shift, her hands strong, warm, and exact. "You carry tension here," she murmurs, sliding her oiled palms lower down your bare back to your waist. "And here. I find I enjoy touching you more than anticipated."

image.comp: standing behind him, working his shoulders, a very faint smile at the corner of her mouth
image.setting: small storeroom turned massage room with warm oil lamp

2.goRes: She studies your face, gives a single decisive nod as if concluding an experiment, and reaches straight for your belt with oiled hands.
2.waitRes: "Very well." Utterly deadpan, yet she drapes a warm blanket carefully over your shoulders before leaving.

3.title: Hypothesis
3.text: Byleth knocks at midnight and steps inside before you even answer, standing straight-backed in a loose sleeping shift that leaves her thighs bare. "I have formed a hypothesis," she announces, gripping the doorknob white-knuckled. "I believe I want to spend the night naked in your bed. I wish to test it immediately."

image.comp: standing very straight in a doorway, gripping the doorknob, deadpan with a flicker of nerves
image.setting: Sam's room at midnight, a single candle

3.goRes: She strips off her shift with clinical precision—and once you're inside her, her deadpan composure shatters into breathless gasps. In the morning she whispers that the results are conclusive.
3.waitRes: "Acceptable." She nods once, ears crimson. "I will refine the parameters. Do not keep me waiting too long."

jump.title: Silent Type
jump.text: During an afternoon sparring drill on the back lawn, Byleth sweeps your legs and pins you flat in the grass, straddling your hips with one hand braced beside your head. Her braid has come loose, her chest is heaving against yours, and her eyes darken as she feels you beneath her. "...I appear to have forgotten the lesson," she murmurs.

image.comp: kneeling over him in the grass, one hand braced beside his head, deadpan but visibly flustered
image.setting: training lawn behind the house in afternoon sun

jump.goRes: She blinks once, kisses you hungrily in the grass, and drags you straight upstairs to study anatomy firsthand.
jump.waitRes: "Dismissed." She stands and offers a hand, face completely neutral while her ears burn bright red. "Tomorrow. Same time."

1.title: Morning Prayer
1.text: Celica kneels in prayer at the sunlit hall window before every shift. This morning you kneel quietly beside her, and she opens one eye with a warm, radiant smile. "You aren't much for hymns, are you?" she whispers, laying her fingers gently over yours. "That's alright—I think you pray with your kindness."

image.comp: kneeling by a sunlit window with folded hands, one eye open and smiling at him
image.setting: staff hall window with morning light and a small shrine candle

1.goRes: Her lips are soft, warm, and quietly joyful, parting beneath yours before she laughs breathlessly. "I think the saints are blushing."
1.waitRes: "Of course." She bows her head and peeks through her lashes. "I'll place you right at the top of my prayers."

2.title: The Missing Friend
2.text: Celica sits on the back stone steps at twilight, turning an old charm over in her fingers. "I traveled all this way searching for someone I lost," she says softly, leaning her head against your shoulder and sliding her hand onto your knee. "Instead I found a home—and a man who truly listens. Is it selfish to want your touch?"

image.comp: seated on stone steps holding a small charm, leaning her head on his shoulder, hopeful and a little sad
image.setting: back steps of the house at twilight, herbs growing by the wall

2.goRes: You tell her it isn't selfish at all, and in the quiet inside she lets you explore her bare skin, trembling and breathless under your hands.
2.waitRes: "Yes." She presses the charm to her chest with a soft smile. "I will be patient—thank you for lending me your shoulder."

3.title: Blessing
3.text: Celica appears in your bedroom doorway in a sheer white sleeping gown, hands clasped nervously at her chest as lamplight outlines every curve beneath the fabric. "I prayed for guidance tonight," she whispers, cheeks flushed bright pink. "And the only answer I heard was: 'Be brave. Be his.' I do hope that wasn't blasphemy."

image.comp: standing in a white sleeping gown with hands clasped at her chest, flushed, hopeful smile
image.setting: Sam's bedroom with a single candle and a rain-streaked window

3.goRes: You assure her it wasn't blasphemy as you peel off the white gown and make love to her slowly, interrupted only by soft gasps and breathless giggles.
3.waitRes: "I am nearly sure." She nods resolutely, blushing. "Nearly is enough for faith—let me be sure for both of us soon."

jump.title: Brave Steps
jump.text: Celica stumbles on the cellar stairs carrying a bottle of wine, and you catch her flush against your chest. Frozen in your arms with her hands fisted in your hoodie, she looks up with sudden, reckless heat. "I have spent my whole life trying to be proper," she whispers, pressing her hips against yours. "Just once, I want to give in to temptation."

image.comp: caught mid-stumble in his arms, hand clutching his hoodie, kissing him with flushed surprise
image.setting: narrow cellar staircase with wine racks and dim lantern light

jump.goRes: She lets out a breathless gasp as you kiss her hungrily, abandoning the wine bottle on the steps to carry her straight to your bed.
jump.waitRes: "Right—yes!" Mortified and radiant, she steadies herself. "I'll watch my step... and take the next one with you later."
